business_summary: Poly Xverse Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells toys in Hong Kong, Mainland China, the United States, Canada, and Japan. It engages in the plantation and sale of agricultural products; and manufacture and sale of hard and stuffed toys. The company was formerly known as Winshine Science Company Limited and changed its name to Poly Xverse Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd in March 2026. Poly Xverse Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Poly Xverse Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd는 홍콩, 중국 본토, 미국, 캐나다 및 일본에서 장난감을 제조 및 판매합니다. 농산물 재배 및 판매에 종사합니다. 딱딱한 장난감과 봉제인형의 제조 및 판매. 이 회사는 이전에 Winshine Science Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2026년 3월에 이름을 Poly Xverse Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd로 변경했습니다. Poly Xverse Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd는 2001년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
